grammar_distinctions_required_by_MEM: P_in versus P_out is required: MEM03 instantiates both with different frozen nodes; MEM05 only P_in; MEM02/MEM06 only P_out.
C and Q must remain distinct: MEM02 requires C with Q absent, while MEM03/MEM06 require Q with C absent.
Pi must remain distinct from X: MEM01/MEM04 carry source-declared Pi coordinates in addition to X coordinates.
T must remain distinct from K: temporal windows/order/persistence occur independently of whether a direct K transition can be reconstructed.
Multiple O nodes and O-to-O topology must be preservable: MEM06 has basis.o1 studied_item_set and basis.o2 recognition_accuracy.
K must remain non-functional and typed; MEM contains dependence, change, coupling and inferential relations rather than only deterministic update functions.
mem_lane_summary.roles_not_needed_note: No Grammar-v0 role is globally unused across MEM01-MEM06. This is a lane-level statement only; no single MEM claim instantiates every role.
residual_structures_not_expressible_by_G: Neutral source-declared condition/event nodes not justified as C, Q, T or P: clearest in MEM06 foil_similarity_condition; also MEM05 initial_acquisition and later_retrieval retain identities beyond bare T indices.
Cross-role and higher-arity K topology without a frozen X carrier or without the Config->Pin->Config signature of PR #322: MEM03 and MEM04 are the clearest pressures.
Required O without frozen P_out/read relation (MEM05) and P_out->O without frozen X (MEM03/MEM06) are not direct instances of PR #322 observe.
O-to-O inferential/lower-bound topology in MEM06 is not a direct rho relation.
possible_compression_derived_feature_cas: Old P compresses usefully into directional P_in/P_out.

Some null-axis ClaimIR conditions compress into existing roles only when structural evidence licenses it: MEM02 qualifying-limit conditions -> C; MEM03 retention_interval -> T. This cannot be generalized to all conditions.
Q covers both scoring and correctness criteria without requiring a scalar universal Q.
O_information and O_outcome can share an O carrier family, but MEM06 shows that their multiplicity and directed relation must remain explicit.

No MEM claim supplies a clean frozen witness for 'persistence = identity-like carry across T'. Persistence remains a T feature in MEM01/MEM03/MEM05/MEM06 unless later evidence supplies an explicit carry relation.
potential_threats_to_Grammar_v0: The frozen role inventory lacks a neutral context/experimental-condition carrier. MEM06 is a direct bounded pressure because foil_similarity_condition cannot be retyped without violating the frozen adjudication.

The Discussion-level K is broader than the merged Lean K signature. If PR #322 transition is intended as exhaustive rather than one carrier realization, MEM01/MEM03/MEM04/MEM05/MEM06 expose signature pressure.
The merged Lean observe signature is stricter than some frozen O structures: MEM05 has O without P_out, and MEM03/MEM06 have P_out/O without X.
Pi-as-Part is not sufficient by itself for MEM04, where the Pi object participates as the subject of dependence and conjunctive characterization.
The candidate compression of persistence into K-carry is not supported by this MEM lane.

counterexample_assessment.statement: MEM provides bounded counterexamples to the claim that frozen Grammar v0, as currently role-specified and Lean-realized, directly preserves all MEM topology without bridge assumptions.
counterexample_assessment.qualification: This does not refute the usefulness of the eight-role vocabulary. MEM02 is a full direct fit and MEM01/MEM03/MEM04 have broad role-level homes. The failure is direct-expressibility/topology preservation, not total role-vocabulary collapse.
